name: vm-win-jumpbox
idleSource: no CPU data in last 90 days (90+)
costSource: estimated (Standard_B2ms Windows list price, canadacentral, Retail Prices API)
reason: Power state is Stopped (not deallocated), so compute is still billed
suggestedAction: Deallocate it to stop compute billing (its disks keep billing), or delete it if it's no longer needed. Deallocating releases dynamic public IPs.
